world-on-fire.name: War
world-on-fire.line: I'm scared that war will reach people and places I care about.
world-on-fire.why: Keeps the plain name and the people and places I care about, but says the feeling out loud the way a person would, instead of the stiffer "I see war threatening".

world-on-fire.name: War and conflict
world-on-fire.line: I'm afraid the wars and conflicts in the world keep getting closer to home.
world-on-fire.why: Brings back the wider sense the ID names (war and chaos spreading, from the earlier line "War and chaos feel closer every year") while staying one plain worry.

crime-and-violence.name: Crime
crime-and-violence.line: Crime and violence keep hurting people in my community.
crime-and-violence.why: Makes this the shared, societal pain (people getting hurt around me) so it reads differently from the personal "I don't feel safe where I live", using the earlier alias's idea that it keeps happening.
